doc_title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of shares of blankpad Inc. (making it a wholly-owned subsidiary)
doc_title_jp: 株式会社blankpadの株式取得（完全子会社化）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 人材マッチングプラットフォーム事業のシナジー創出、調剤薬局の採用マッチング精度向上

summary_en: Kusurinomadoguchi acquires 100% of blankpad via board resolution on 2026-07-23 to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Blankpad operates a personality-diagnosis and AI-powered talent-matching platform. Acquisition purpose: combine blankpad's analysis capabilities with Kusurinomadoguchi's existing pharmacist recruitment subsidiary to improve matching precision and retention in pharmacy staffing.
summary_jp: くすりの窓口が2026年7月23日の取締役会決議でblankpadを100%取得し完全子会社化。blankpadはパーソナリティ診断とAI分析による総合人材マッチングプラットフォームを展開。既存の薬剤師求人転職子会社との事業シナジー創出により、調剤薬局向けマッチング精度・定着率向上を目的。
tag_en: Kusurinomadoguchi acquires blankpad 100% (full subsidiary) - personality-matching platform - 2026-07-23
tag_jp: くすりの窓口がblankpad 100%取得（完全子会社化）- パーソナリティマッチングプラットフォーム - 2026-07-23

summary_en: 400,000 shares (3.51% of S/O) authorized, ¥800M ceiling, increased by 285,000 shares and ¥500M from prior June 5 authorization. Open-market acquisition through Tokyo Stock Exchange via discretionary trading agreement, June 8–December 7, 2026. As of June 26, cumulative acquisitions: 69,700 shares, ¥178.9M.
